title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-06-22
content:
Infrastructure Weekly Update - 2026-06-22

Owner: Aisha Khan (eng-infrastructure)
Collaborators: Miguel Ramirez, Priya Desai, Ethan Zhang
Status: In review

High-level summary:
- Stable week for serving runtime overall; p99 token latency within SLO for 92% of routes.
- GPU fleet utilization climbed to 76% average (from 68% last week) due to two large customer batch jobs and an internal eval run.
- We added capacity for EU-West and US-East to cover forecasted demand spikes next month.

Fleet status and capacity changes:
- New capacity provisioned:
  - +8 A800 nodes (64GB, FP16 optimized) deployed in eu-west-1 (cluster: eu-inference-1). Online as of 2026-06-21 04:30 UTC.
  - +4 A100 nodes moved from staging to us-east-2 to handle Dedicated burst commitments. Migration completed 2026-06-20 22:10 UTC.
- Decommission planned:
  - 6x V100 nodes (legacy) scheduled for decommission on 2026-07-05 after final model validation and KV cache migration. Owners: Miguel.
- Utilization & thermal notes:
  - Avg GPU utilization: 76% (up from 68%). Peak sustained periods on Tue/Wed between 14:00-18:00 UTC.
  - Observed elevated NVLINK error rate on two A100 hosts in us-west-2; hardware vendor opened ticket JIRA-INFRA-8421. Nodes isolated and traffic drained; no customer impact reported.

Regions & routing:
- EU-West: Added +8 A800s; routing policy updated to prefer eu-inference-1 for eu-* routes. Latency improved ~12% for long-context workloads.
- US-East: Rebalanced Dedicated pools to reduce cold-starts; added pre-warmed instances for top 5 Dedicated customers in us-east-2.
- APAC: No new capacity this week. Monitoring shows saturation risk window on 2026-07-10 if current growth continues. Recommend preemptive capacity commit (see Capacity Planning).

Incidents and current investigations:
- 2026-06-19 15:38 UTC: Elevated 503 rate for short-lived chat routes in us-west-2. Root cause: autoscaler race condition under bursty load >18k rps. Mitigation: turned on conservative cooldown for autoscale policy and rolled a hotfix (PR #614) to reduce thundering herd. Post-mitigation error rate back to base.
- NVLINK errors (mentioned above) ongoing investigation with vendor; replacement schedule tentative 2026-06-29 if no remote fix.

Capacity planning & forecast:
- Forecast assumptions: 18% month-over-month growth in hosted API token volume; 12% MoM growth in Dedicated commitments.
- Actionable asks:
  - Approve one-time capacity purchase of 12x A800 (eu-west or apac depending on pricing) to cover projected July/August spikes. Finance needs estimate by 2026-06-26.
  - Sales / Account Execs: freeze new large Dedicated onboards targeting APAC until week of 2026-06-29 unless we greenlight extra capacity.
- Short-term runway: With planned deployments (including decommission and node moves), runway before hitting 85% utilization in APAC is ~18 days.

Performance tuning & optimizations:
- Batching: Rolled conservative batching policy for chat-small routes; average tokens/sec per GPU increased by ~9% during peak.
- KV cache: Enabled prefix cache for large-context Llama-family models in eu-west-1; cache hit-rate now 42% (was 18%).

Operational tasks & maintenance:
- Scheduled maintenance windows:
  - 2026-06-28 02:00-06:00 UTC: kernel/security patches on us-east-2 node pool (impact: brief rolling drains).
  - 2026-06-29 03:00-08:00 UTC: planned vendor-led firmware updates on selected A100 hosts (in us-west-2); will pre-drain nodes.
- Automation: Improvements to drain/playbook (docs CONFLUENCE-Infra/Node-Drain-Playbook) to reduce migration delta during decommission; next PR planned by Priya.

Risks & open blockers:
- Pending approval for cross-region capacity budget for APAC (Finance approval required).
- NVLINK hardware replacements could cause brief capacity loss in us-west-2 if parts shipped late. Contingency: shift routing to us-east until replacements complete.
- Autoscaler race condition patch needs longer soak on staging (tracking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/614).

Action items (owners):
- Miguel: finalize V100 decommission checklist and schedule (due 2026-06-25).
- Priya: prepare cost estimate for 12x A800 purchase (due 2026-06-26).
- Ethan: continue vendor engagement for NVLINK fixes and draft replacement plan (due 2026-06-24).
- Aisha: coordinate with Sales to pause new APAC Dedicated onboards until capacity decision (done: 2026-06-22 email thread).

Standups & meeting notes (this week):
- Mon 2026-06-22 09:00 UTC — Weekly infra sync:
  - Quick status: EU capacity online; autoscaler hotfix landed.
  - Decision: expedite cost estimate for APAC purchase.
  - Blocker: NVLINK replacement ETA uncertain.
- Tue 2026-06-23 16:00 UTC — Post-incident review (503 burst):
  - Findings: autoscaler cooldown threshold too low for bursty patterns; mitigation accepted.
  - Follow-ups: add synthetic burst tests in load harness (Jenkins job: infra-burst-e2e).

Notes to execs / TL;DR for leadership:
- Short-term: Fleet stable, but utilization trending up — approving a 12-node A800 purchase for APAC/EU will buy runway through Q3.
- Medium-term: Replace legacy V100s and continue to move capacity to A800/A100 class for better perf/watt.
- Immediate ask: Finance sign-off for capacity purchase estimate by 2026-06-26.

Appendix: Useful links
- Incident doc: CONFLUENCE-Infra/Incident-2026-06-19-autoscaler-race
- Hardware ticket: JIRA-INFRA-8421
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/614
- Drain playbook: CONFLUENCE-Infra/Node-Drain-Playbook

End of update.
